name: Hausen ob Verena (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically blue and yellow, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Hausen ob Verena (Saint Verena on blue and yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Hausen ob Verena; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Hausen ob Verena arms — Saint Verena
